_about: 2026 年 1–6 月全球均温是否高于任何往年同期的冻结证据包。信息截至 2026-06-30；三条 Copernicus 月报均可核实在截点前发布。

evidence.title: Copernicus: Fifth-warmest January sees 2026 start with weather extremes
evidence.excerpt: January 2026 was the fifth-warmest January globally.
evidence.claim: 官方月报显示 2026 年 1 月仅为历史第 5 暖，对上半年创同期新高形成反向证据。

evidence.title: Copernicus: Exceptionally wet conditions in western Europe, during fifth-warmest February globally
evidence.excerpt: February 2026 was the fifth warmest on record, at 1.49°C above pre-industrial levels.
evidence.claim: 官方月报显示 2026 年 2 月为历史第 5 暖，进一步削弱 1–6 月整体创历史同期新高的依据。

evidence.title: Copernicus: Second-highest surface air and sea surface temperatures for May globally
evidence.excerpt: May 2026 was the second-warmest May globally in the ERA5 dataset.
evidence.claim: 官方月报显示 2026 年 5 月为历史第 2 暖而非第 1，继续提供未创月度纪录的事前证据。
